'''Kevin Hervey''' (born July 9, 1996)<ref>{{cite web|title=25 – Kevin Hervey|url=http://www.nbadraft.net/players/kevin-hervey|website=NBA Draft.net|access-date=June 13, 2017}}</ref> is an American professional [[basketball]] player, who most recently played for [[U-BT Cluj-Napoca]] of the Romanian [[Liga Națională (men's basketball)|Liga Națională de Baschet Masculin]] (LNBM) and the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]]. He played college basketball for the [[UT Arlington Mavericks men's basketball|UT Arlington Mavericks]].

== College career ==
Hervey came into [[Texas-Arlington Mavericks men's basketball|UT Arlington]] at only 180 pounds before eventually reaching 210 pounds by his senior season. Hervey played four years for the Mavericks. In his sophomore season, Hervey averaged 18.1 points and 9.8 rebounds per game. He missed the last 19 games of the season due to a [[torn ACL]] in his left knee.

As a junior, Hervey averaged 17.1 points and 8.5 rebounds per game but had some lingering effects from the ACL tear in the early season. He led the Mavericks to a 27–9 season, the most wins in school history, and NIT quarterfinal run. He was named [[Sun Belt Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Sun Belt Conference Player of the Year]] and earned all-district honors from both the [[National Association of Basketball Coaches]] and the [[U.S. Basketball Writers Association]]. Hervey is the second Texas–Arlington player after [[Marquez Haynes]] to be named an [[Associated Press|AP]] Honorable Mention [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Martinez|first1=Matthew|title=UTA's Hervey becomes school's second-ever AP All-American|url=http://www.star-telegram.com/sports/college/mens-basketball/article141463124.html|access-date=June 13, 2017|work=[[Fort Worth Star-Telegram]]|date=March 29, 2017}}</ref> He was twice named Sun Belt Player of the Week, on December 6, 2016, and February 20, 2017.<ref name="SUN BELT POY">{{cite press release|url=http://sunbeltsports.org/news/2017/3/5/GENERAL_0305170603.aspx?path=mbball |title=UTA's Hervey, Cross cap memorable season with individual honors |publisher=Sun Belt Conference |date=March 6, 2017 |access-date=March 7, 2017}}</ref>

As a senior, Hervey averaged 21.1 points and 8.7 rebounds per game. He was named to the first-team All-Sun Belt team for the second consecutive year.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.utamavs.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/030518aaa.html|title=MBB: Hervey, Neal earn all-Sun Belt honors|access-date=2018-04-20}}{{Dead link|date=December 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>

==Professional career==

===Oklahoma City Blue (2018–2020)===
Hervey was chosen with 57th pick in the [[2018 NBA draft]] by the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sportsday.dallasnews.com/college-sports/collegesports/2018/06/21/x-select-ut-arlingtons-kevin-hervey-nba-drafts-2nd-round|title=Oklahoma City Thunder select UT-Arlington's Kevin Hervey in NBA draft's 2nd round|last=Lopez|first=Selby|date=June 21, 2018|access-date=June 22, 2018}}{{Dead link|date=December 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref> He became the fourth player from the University of Texas-Arlington to be selected in an [[NBA draft]], with the last players being selected in 1982. Hervey averaged 7.2 points, 2.6 rebounds and one assist per game in five summer league games. On October 5, 2018, he was signed by the Thunder's G League affiliate [[Oklahoma City Blue]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Afseth |first1=Grant |title=Thunder draft pick Kevin Hervey will play this season for the OKC Blue |url=https://okcthunderwire.usatoday.com/2018/10/05/oklahoma-city-thunder-draft-pick-kevin-hervey-okc-blue-g-league/ |access-date=October 5, 2018 |work=Thunder Wire |date=October 5, 2018}}</ref>

===Oklahoma City Thunder (2019–2020)===
On December 12, 2019, the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] announced that they had signed a [[two-way contract]] with Hervey.<ref>{{cite news|title=Thunder Signs Kevin Hervey to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/thunder/news/release-hervey-191212|website=NBA.com|access-date=December 12, 2019}}</ref> Throughout the contract, Hervey would split his playing time between the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] and their [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[Oklahoma City Blue]]. In nine games, Hervey averaged 1.7 points and 1.2 rebounds per game for the Thunder.<ref name="yahyabeyoglu" />

===Lokomotiv Kuban (2020–2021)===
On September 20, 2020, Hervey signed a one-year deal<ref>{{cite web|title=Loko signed Kevin Hervey|url=https://lokobasket.com/en/news/118337|date=September 21, 2020|website=lokobasket.com|access-date=September 21, 2020}}</ref> with [[PBC Lokomotiv-Kuban|Lokomotiv Kuban]] of the [[VTB United League]] and the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]].<ref name="yahyabeyoglu">{{cite web |last1=Yahyabeyoglu |first1=Fersu |title=Lokomotiv tabs Kevin Hervey |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Eurocup/news/645333/Lokomotiv-tabs-Kevin-Hervey |website=Eurobasket |access-date=September 20, 2020 |date=September 20, 2020}}</ref>

===Virtus Bologna (2021–2022)===
On July 10, 2021, Hervey signed a two-years deal with [[Virtus Bologna]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]].<ref>{{cite web |title=KEVIN HERVEY IS A NEW VIRTUS SEGAFREDO BOLOGNA PLAYER! |url=https://www.virtus.it/en/news/kevin-hervey-is-a-new-virtus-segafredo-bologna-player/ |website=virtus.it |date=10 July 2021 |language=Italian |access-date=July 10, 2021 |archive-date=July 10, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210710165831/https://www.virtus.it/en/news/kevin-hervey-is-a-new-virtus-segafredo-bologna-player/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> On September 21, the team won its second [[2021 Italian Basketball Supercup|Supercup]], defeating [[Olimpia Milano]] 90–84.<ref>[https://www.repubblica.it/sport/basket/2021/09/21/news/basket_supercoppa_alla_virtus_bologna_il_primo_trofeo_stagionale_milano_ancora_ko-318837432/ Basket, la Virtus Bologna vince la Supercoppa: Milano ancora ko], ''la Repubblica''</ref> Moreover, after having ousted [[BC Lietkabelis|Lietkabelis]], [[Ratiopharm Ulm|Ulm]] and [[Valencia Basket|Valencia]] in the first three rounds of the [[2022 EuroCup Basketball Playoffs|playoffs]], on 11 May 2022, Virtus defeated [[Bursaspor Basketbol|Frutti Extra Bursaspor]] by 80–67 at the Segafredo Arena, winning its first [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]] and qualifying for the [[EuroLeague]] after 14 years.<ref>{{cite web |title=Game Night: Virtus is the 7DAYS EuroCup champion and headed back to the EuroLeague! |url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/eurocup/news/game-night-a-new-7days-eurocup-champ-is-crowned-tonight/?pageTitle=Homepage&historyUrl=/eurocup/ |website=euroleaguebasketball.net |date=11 May 2022 |access-date=May 12, 2022 |archive-date=May 11, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220511221231/https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/eurocup/news/game-night-a-new-7days-eurocup-champ-is-crowned-tonight/?pageTitle=Homepage&historyUrl=/eurocup/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> However, despite having ended the regular season at the first place and having ousted 3–0 both [[U.S. Victoria Libertas Pallacanestro|Pesaro]] and [[Derthona Basket|Tortona]] in the first two rounds of playoffs, Virtus was defeated 4–2 in the national finals by Olimpia Milan.<ref>{{cite web |title=Olimpia Milano campione d'Italia, Virtus Bologna ko 81–64 in gara-6|url=https://sport.sky.it/basket/serie-a/2022/06/18/olimpia-milano-virtus-bologna-risultato|website=Sky Sport|date=18 June 2022}}</ref>

===Pallacanestro Reggiana (2023–2024)===
On July 9, 2023, he signed with [[Pallacanestro Reggiana]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.pallacanestroreggiana.it/news/tutte-le-news/kevin-hervey-e-il-primo-rinforzo|title=Kevin Hervey È Il Primo Rinforzo!|last=|first=|date=July 9, 2023|website=pallacanestroreggiana.it|publisher=|language=it|access-date=July 17, 2023}}{{Dead link|date=December 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>

===U-BT Cluj-Napoca (2024)===
On July 22, 2024, Hervey signed with [[U-BT Cluj-Napoca]] of the [[Liga Națională (men's basketball)|Liga Națională de Baschet Masculin]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Kevin Hervey, jucător cu prezențe în NBA și fost câștigător al EuroCup, vine să o întărească pe U-Banca Transilvania|url=https://www.u-bt.ro/seniori/stiri/kevin-harvey-jucator-cu-prezente-in-nba-si-fost-castigator-al-eurocup-vine-sa-o-intareasca-pe-u-banca-transilvania|website=U-BT.ro|date=July 22, 2024|access-date=July 22, 2024|language=Romanian}}</ref> On November 8, he was released by Cluj.<ref>{{cite web |title=Mulțumim, Kevin Hervey! |url=https://www.u-bt.ro/seniori/stiri/multumim-kevin-hervey |website=U-BT |access-date=January 4, 2025 |date=November 9, 2024}}</ref>
